creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`Sidebar.swift:838` has `row.tab != nil` on a non-optional String, so the comparison always passes and the compiler warns.

Harmless today - a pane row always has a tab - so the guard has never been wrong, only useless. Noticed by slot 2 while building a_2LSUoy7dd and left alone rather than adding an unrelated line to that diff.

Either drop the comparison or make the field optional if a row without a tab is a state that can happen.
title: Sidebar.swift compares a non-optional String against nil
